meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: 把你的数据套用「Setup → Conflict → Resolution」叙事框架,产出带可视化和业务上下文的洞察报告,让非技术受众看懂结论与下一步行动。
howto.when: 当你向高管汇报、制作季度业务回顾或投资者演示,需要把枯燥数据讲成故事时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这份季度数据做成给高管看的故事化幻灯片流程
say.note: 生成多页叙事幻灯片结构

say.text: 给这个市场机会对比写一条带数字的标题和推荐结论
say.note: 给出带数字的标题与建议

howto.what_en: Applies a Setup-Conflict-Resolution narrative framework to your raw data, producing insight reports with visuals and business context so non-technical audiences grasp the conclusion and next steps.
howto.when_en: Use it when presenting analytics to executives, preparing quarterly business reviews or investor decks, or explaining dry data to non-technical audiences.

say_en.text: Write up this churn data as a Setup-Conflict-Resolution exec brief
say_en.note: Frames your data as an exec brief

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly data into a story-driven slide flow for leadership
Draft a headline with numbers and a recommendation for this market comparison
say_en.note: Returns a data headline plus recommendation
